SMTO-GML-0063 — The Gateway for this Gmail account needs an update

GUID: 27098fe1-0d20-4db9-b0f7-705b564fcc29
Slug: gmail-gateway-upgrade-required
Domain: GML · Subsystem: gmail-client-actions

What happened

  • This Gmail account signs in with an app password, so SMTO reaches it through a Gateway (the helper program that runs work on a computer). That Gateway is too old for this email action, so SMTO stopped before changing any email.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Let any running Tasks on that Gateway finish, then open Settings › Setup › Gateways, select Check for updates, and update the Gateway. A newer Gateway adds the email actions this request needs, and updating stops whatever is still running on it.
  2. If the account uses the built-in Gateway, open Settings › Setup › Server updates and install the available update instead. The built-in Gateway is updated together with the SMTO server.
  3. When the Gateway shows as connected again, ask SMTO to repeat the email action. Nothing was changed the first time, so the request is safe to repeat once the Gateway is updated.

What success looks like

  • The Gateway shows as updated and connected in Settings › Setup › Gateways, and the email action runs.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO and its Gateways. Don't change the Gmail app password or switch to another mailbox; this is a version problem, not a sign-in problem.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • The Gateway used by this Gmail app-password account did not advertise Gmail workflow capability version 1 (missing or legacy workflow_capabilities response).

What this means

  • The controller probes the private workflow capability before new IMAP compound operations. Missing or incompatible support is rejected before a mailbox write.

Why this can happen

  • The controller probes the private workflow capability before new IMAP compound operations. Missing or incompatible support is rejected before a mailbox write.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect the selected account, action arguments and operation reference; do not infer mailbox effects from the error alone.

How to fix it

  • Update the selected Gateway (and the Server, for the built-in Gateway) to compatible versions after active work settles, then confirm the account's gmail.capabilities result shows Gateway workflow_version 1. ensure_provider in gmail/workflows rejects the action before any mailbox write.
  • Update the selected Gateway and controller to compatible versions, restart them after active work settles, and check gmail.capabilities.

Retry and execution caution

  • Update the selected Gateway and controller to compatible versions, restart them after active work settles, and check gmail.capabilities.

How to verify the fix

  • The selected Gateway advertises workflow_version 1.

What not to do

  • Do not change passwords or use a different mailbox to bypass a version mismatch.

Technical notes

  • This check rejects new work before its write. It does not undo previous confirmed effects.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
